headline: Big Tech AI Investments Drive Up Capital Expenditure and Concern Wall Street
summary: Amazon announced swelling investments in artificial intelligence amid stumbling share prices, joining other major technology companies expanding data center spending.
why: Large cloud and AI providers require massive capital expenditure for data center infrastructure, impacting free cash flow and near-term returns for major technology equities.

impacts.name: Amazon
impacts.why: Rising capital expenditures on artificial intelligence infrastructure weighed on investor sentiment and share prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Announcements of surging AI infrastructure spending raised concerns about near-term free cash flow, leading to stumbling share prices.
